svg.text: Ramp editing · central workspace + selected-step inspector
V1 proposal • 22 November 2026 • Static wireframe; not implemented
HEX is an sRGB preview · Alpha 100% for all steps
Selecting a swatch keeps the full ramp visible. Editing affects only that step.
Recipe seed and neighbouring steps are unchanged.
Your draft changes the token, not the seed.
Proposal: component rows are the editing surface; precise input, alpha and token details stay in the inspector.
